newsitem.title: UK: Granada off on Yorkshire-Tyne H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Granada off on Yorkshire-Tyne H1 results.

text.p: Shares in media and leisure company Granada Group fell after Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television, in which Granada has a 24 percent stake, said its advertising revenues were below budget.
By 0928 GMT, Granada's shares were off 16-1/2p. Shares in Yorkshire-Tyne Tees were down 10p to 1230p.

Yorkshire-Tyne Tees, one of the regional ITV television companies, reported its first half profits jumped to 13.3 million stg from 7.4 million stg a year ago, but added that its advertising revnue in the first half was "well short of budget."
Shares in other television broadcasters were also down. Shares in Carlton Communications fell 7p to 478-1/2p and shares in United News & Media eased 9-1/2p to 713p.
